name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Audhan Yojana
benefit:
The benefits in the form of compensation provided:
I)Death - Rs. 2 lakhs II) Disablement - Rs. 1 lakh /- or 2 lakhs a) Loss of one limb or one Eye - Rs. 1 Lakhs b) Loss of two limbs or two Eyes- Rs. 2 lakhs c) Loss of one limb and one Eye - Rs. 2 lakhs
_eligibility_text: 1) Registered farmer in the age group of 10 -75 years. 2) Person registered as farmer in Maharashtra as evidenced by 7/12 extract. 3) All 1.52 crore farmers of the state and one family member from their family.
